content.comment_body: Hello, I have a problem and would like to run some experiments with temperature sensors. I am aware that the [product_name] module, with or without the [product_name] expansion module ([article_no] for Pt100), is compatible with Pt100 sensors. After welding the sensor connections and testing with my digital temperature meter, it displays the correct temperature. I suspect my sensor is not an actual Pt100. Is it possible to use this sensor together with the [product_name] module? I would appreciate any clarification. Best regards, [user_name]
Hello [user_name], I recommend purchasing a genuine Pt100 sensor because they require precision manufacturing for accurate measurements. For more details, please check [url].

analysis.insight_summary: The user is asking about the possibility of using a self-made or non-standard temperature sensor with [product_name] modules that are designed for Pt100 sensors, highlighting uncertainty regarding compatibility and sensor support. Another user advises using an authentic Pt100 sensor to ensure measurement accuracy and refers to potential problems when using improvised sensors.
